### Analysis

- Summarise protein matrix

```{r}

annotation_df <- reshape2::melt(as.matrix(erap2_ov_df[-1,c(41, 42, 43)]))
genes_df <- annotation_df[annotation_df$Var2 == "T..Genes",]
protein_df <- annotation_df[annotation_df$Var2 == "T..Protein.Group",]
gene_to_protein_df <- reshape2::acast(annotation_df, formula = Var1 ~ Var2, value.var = "value")

melt_erap2_ov_df <- reshape2::melt(as.matrix(erap2_ov_df[-1,c(1:27)]))
colnames(melt_erap2_ov_df) <-c("row_x", "variable", "value")

variable_split <- str_split(melt_erap2_ov_df$variable, pattern = "[_,.]", simplify = T)[,-c(1)]


melt_erap2_ov_df$line <- variable_split[,1]
melt_erap2_ov_df$erap2 <- variable_split[,2]
melt_erap2_ov_df$replicate <- variable_split[,3]
melt_erap2_ov_df$sample_name <- paste(melt_erap2_ov_df$line, melt_erap2_ov_df$erap2, sep = "_")
melt_erap2_ov_df$unique_sample_name <- paste(melt_erap2_ov_df$line, melt_erap2_ov_df$erap2, melt_erap2_ov_df$replicate, sep = "_")
melt_erap2_ov_df$Genes <- genes_df[match(melt_erap2_ov_df$row_x, genes_df$Var1),"value"]
melt_erap2_ov_df$protein_id <- protein_df[match(melt_erap2_ov_df$row_x, protein_df$Var1),"value"]
melt_erap2_ov_df$value <- as.numeric(melt_erap2_ov_df$value)


non_na_keep_melt_erap2_kd_df <-  melt_erap2_ov_df[!is.na(melt_erap2_ov_df$value) & melt_erap2_ov_df$Genes != "NA" & melt_erap2_ov_df$Genes != "",]

protein_matrix <- reshape2::acast(data = non_na_keep_melt_erap2_kd_df, formula = Genes ~ unique_sample_name, value.var = "value")
experiment_df <- unique(non_na_keep_melt_erap2_kd_df[,c("line", "erap2", "sample_name", "unique_sample_name")])


protein_sparsity <- rowSums(protein_matrix == 0 | is.na(protein_matrix)) / ncol(protein_matrix)
average_signal <- rowMeans(protein_matrix, na.rm = T)
summarised_protein_matrix <- do.call(cbind, lapply(split(experiment_df, experiment_df$sample_name), function(temp_df){
    rowSums(protein_matrix[,temp_df$unique_sample_name], na.rm = T) / ncol(protein_matrix[,temp_df$unique_sample_name])
}))


```

```{r}
    keep_experiment_df <- experiment_df[experiment_df$erap2 != "UN",]
```

- Load GSEA enrichment results


```{r}

gsea_results_list <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "03-01-save-list-of-correlated-gsea-terms-in-erap2-ov.rds"))
experiment_df <- gsea_results_list$experiment_matrix

splicing_terms <- gsea_results_list$splicing
lipid_terms <- gsea_results_list$lipid

gsea_results_df <- gsea_results_list$gsea_results


splicing_related_genes <- unique(do.call(c, lapply(gsea_results_df, function(x){
    unique(do.call(c, x$leadingEdge[x$pathway %in% splicing_terms]))
})))

which_splicing_modules <- unique(module_df[module_df[,1] %in% splicing_related_genes,"modules"])

lipid_related_genes <- unique(do.call(c, lapply(gsea_results_df, function(x){
    unique(do.call(c, x$leadingEdge[x$pathway %in% lipid_terms]))
})))
pseudo_module_splicing_lipid <- unique(rbind(module_df[module_df[,1] %in% lipid_related_genes,], module_df[module_df[,1] %in% splicing_related_genes,]))
pseudo_module_splicing_lipid$modules <- "MSpLi"

which_lipid_modules <- unique(module_df[module_df[,1] %in% lipid_related_genes,"modules"])
select_modules <- intersect(which_lipid_modules, which_splicing_modules)

```

- Perform gene set enrichment

```{r}


unloadNamespace("enrichR")
require("enrichR")

current_module_df <- module_df[module_df[,2] %in% select_modules,]
gene_split <- split(pseudo_module_splicing_lipid, pseudo_module_splicing_lipid$modules)

dbs <- "GO_Biological_Process_2023"
groups <- names(gene_split)
module_enrichment_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(a_group){
    a_temp_df <- gene_split[[a_group]]
        db_df_list <- lapply(dbs, function(a_database){
            message(paste(a_database, a_group))
            current_genes <- a_temp_df$genes[a_temp_df$modules == a_group]
            an_enrichment_df <- enrichr(current_genes,  a_database)[[1]]
            if(nrow(an_enrichment_df) == 0){
                return(NULL)
            }
            an_enrichment_df$num_gene <- length(current_genes)
            an_enrichment_df$db <- a_database
            Sys.sleep(5)
            return(an_enrichment_df)
        })
        db_df <- do.call(rbind, db_df_list)
    db_df$modules <- a_group
    return(db_df)
}))


module_enrichment_df$gene_ratio <- vapply(module_enrichment_df$Overlap, function(x){
    eval(parse(text = x))
},1)

write.csv(x = module_enrichment_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "09-02-gene-set-enrichment-analysis-of-coexpression-modules.csv"))


```

- Plot gene set enrichment results

```{r}

require(patchwork)

    my_theme <- theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
        linetype = "dashed",
        size = 0.2))

module_enrichment_split <- split(module_enrichment_df, module_enrichment_df$modules)

plot_list <- lapply(module_enrichment_split, function(temp_df){
    significant_df <- temp_df[temp_df$P.value < 0.05 & temp_df$gene_ratio > 0.1,]
    significant_df <- significant_df[order(significant_df$gene_ratio, decreasing = T),][1:10,]
    significant_df$label <- vapply(str_split(significant_df$Term, pattern = " "), function(x){
        paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = " ")
    },"1")

    significant_df$label <- factor(significant_df$label, levels = significant_df$label[order(-log10(significant_df$P.value), decreasing = F)])
    ThePlot_1 <- ggplot(significant_df, aes(x = -log10(P.value), y = label))
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = direction), colour = "#000000", 
    #     width = 0.5, lwd = 0.5)
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + geom_point(aes(size = gene_ratio), fill = "#F4AC45", colour = "#000000", shape = 21)
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1), colour = "#000000", lty = "dashed")
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + scale_x_continuous("-log10 pvalue")
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + scale_y_discrete("Enriched terms in each module")
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + theme_bw()
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + ggtitle(unique(significant_df$modules))
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + my_theme
})

all_plots <- wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = 1, ncol = 1)
save_plot(ncol = 3, nrow = 3, 
    base_width = 8, base_height = 5,
    file = file.path(plot_dir, "09-03-plot-gene-set-enrichment-of-modules.pdf"), plot = all_plots)

```
